address: 151 Sydney Street, Chelsea, London, SW3 6NT, United Kingdom
bio: In the very heart of Chelsea, the hidden-away Stanley's feels like a perfect fit for the neighbourhood. Plenty of regulars are among the diners seated in either a sheltered, flower-festooned courtyard or inside a lean-to glasshouse. Vibrantly colourful dishes are overtly seasonal and deliver bags of pure, unadulterated flavour thanks to great ingredients – from leeks to pork chops – which are allowed to shine by the chef's understated compositions. When the sun comes out, there's few places better for lunch on a summer's day....
